plan.title: Rejected Bids offered on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the live RFQ scenario.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert Rejected Bids is offered and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Rejected Bids to verify its window opens.
Assert the Rejected Bids window is displayed.
Dismiss the Rejected Bids window without confirming any change.
